## Invitations

The outreach programme issued 1843 invitations during the reporting period. A total of 1216 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 66.0. This result reflects the response to the invitations issued and provides the overall participation position for the period. Delivery arrangements were maintained as far as local conditions permitted. Van days were kept where roads allowed, supporting access for people in areas where travel conditions affected the available approach.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 1557 were accompanied by an SMS. A reminder message was also sent to 1557 people. These contact arrangements provided an additional prompt alongside the original invitation and supported engagement with the outreach activity. The SMS and reminder figures are recorded separately to show the scale of contact undertaken.

Prepared by G. Evans.
